mathematical_contract.rational_source: For an exactly rational native carrier parameter beta, form D(u)*diameter_side(alpha,beta)-A(u)*radius_squared_denominator(alpha,beta)=0 in the selected cusp field, where D(u)=(1-u)^2+u^2 and A(u)=1-2u. Hypersolve supplies all selected-field candidates. Only candidates that promote exactly to Real and compare Equal under the original unsquared retained map are accepted.
mathematical_contract.analytic_source: For an exactly rational analytic-source parameter beta, retain the rational and radical diameter terms separately. Square rational(u)^2*speed_squared-radical(u)^2 only to enumerate candidates, then replay the original unsquared radical predicate. Conjugate selected roots, the opposite normal branch, and squaring artifacts therefore cannot pass STRICT.
mathematical_contract.uniqueness: A mapped cut promotes only when exactly one rational cusp value survives original-map replay. No candidate yields None, multiple candidates yield a topology error, and any unresolved certified predicate remains Classification::Uncertain.
mathematical_contract.policy: Every promotion, reduction, root isolation, comparison, radical sign, and replay receives CurveContext. STRICT accepts proof only. APPROXIMATE_512 can terminate solely through the shared 512-bit Hyperlimit/Hypersolve predicate boundary; neither path introduces binary floating-point geometry.
mathematical_contract.bounded_fallback: A genuinely non-rational unrelated mapped value remains mapped and returns explicit Unsupported at cross-field inversion. It is never rounded into a parameter or point.

capability.comparison_revision: A cusp cut could invert only through the same retained map or when already authored as Exact(Real). A rational-valued cut retained by another rational or analytic map therefore blocked overlap clipping.
capability.source_revision: Unrelated rational and analytic maps can prove and cache an exact rational cusp value, replay it through a rebuilt destination map, close a cusp fragment against its exact chord point, and complete CurveRegion2 intersection and Boolean topology.
